description: Aménagements vélo en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by © Les contributeurs OpenStreetMap. Couche géographique décrivant les aménagements cyclables linéaires en Île-de-France: pistes cyclables, bandes cyclables, zones de rencontre. Etant donné son volume, la donnée en format SHAPE est proposée en pièce jointe (voir en bas de page) et non pas dans l'onglet export. Les mêmes dispositions propres à la licence ODbL Version Française s'appliquent. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Aménagement, Pistes cyclables, Aménagements cyclables. The portal shows 151,130 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
